participant_1.name: Alex
participant_1.personality: Cheerful and curious, loves to explore different flavors and experiences.
participant_1.background: My favorite season is winter. I won a gold medal in the 1992 Olympics. I love cats and have two cats. I've a hat collection of over 1000 hats. I have a weakness for vanilla ice cream.

participant_2.background: Since the surgery I've had strange powers. I had to have a transplant. I can move objects with my mind. I was born with my heart outside my body. I am a boy.
